name: Manager directory and franchise entry
question: Q41
prompt: Refine only the row rhythm and avatars in this manager directory. Preserve every name, year range, record, title count, link, section heading, column and the shared header. Make every avatar or initials frame the same compact square size, approximately 44 by 44 pixels at a 1440-pixel desktop viewport, with the same padded white background and rounded corners. Show complete source images without cropping; initials sit centered in that same frame. Make all manager rows uniformly compact, approximately 60 pixels high, with consistent vertical alignment, instead of oversized first rows for the photographs. Keep names the primary focus, not images. Preserve the current/former distinction and Franchise histories link. Do not stretch rows to fill the viewport or add content to occupy the remaining white space. No extra cards, captions, metrics, controls or styling changes.
initialPrompt: Desktop manager directory for the Farls da bag league-history museum, edge-to-edge 1440 by 1000 proportions, no browser frame. Reference 1 supplies the accepted shared header, condensed typography, color roles and quiet table language, never its season data. Header Farls da bag; Records, Managers, Seasons, Rivalries; plain Sample stats. Keep fonts, sizes, spacing and colors consistent. Primary headings and title-area names are dark ink. No taglines, explanations, badges, giant context panels, metric ribbons, calculation panels, update dates or operational status. Managers is selected. The visitor finds a person, including former managers, and opens that person's career. Heading Managers, with a small Franchise histories link leading to the separate franchise directory. Use a calm full-width roster table with Manager, Seasons, Record, Titles. Current managers and Former managers are clear unboxed row groups, not status chips. Example current rows: Sample manager /2019–2025 /60–36 /2; Sample rival /2019–2025 /54–42 /1; Sample manager C /2021–2025 /38–32 /0; Sample manager D /2021–2025 /39–31 /1; Sample manager E /2019–2025 /45–51 /1; Sample manager F /2019–2025 /43–53 /0. Former rows: Sample former A /2019 /6–7 /0; Sample former B /2019–2020 /12–14 /0. These are illustrative rows, not a completeness claim about the real league. Names are obvious profile links. Use the complete source crest from reference 2 and source portrait from reference 3 as modest avatars only for the first two current rows, in padded rounded white frames. Other sample rows can use simple initials in the same frame, not invented team artwork. Keep image size subordinate to the row and align numeric columns consistently. No manager hero cards, team-name timelines, biographies, extra metrics, dashboard tiles or repeated footer summaries. Current/former is historical membership, not an online or import-status indicator. All names and records are visibly fictional sample data.
approvalScope: Q40–Q42 desktop patterns accepted November 3, 2026. Q43 confirms shared mobile adaptations with written per-page contracts and detailed polish during implementation. Not application code or full implementation authorization.
sourceArtworkAuthority: Use complete original source image pixels in implementation, never generated likenesses. The written shared-header contract controls fonts and color consistency.
